hints.title: Weighted Discrete Area Selection
hints.text: To ensure each integer point across non-overlapping rectangles has an equal probability of selection, rectangles must be chosen with probability proportional to the number of points they contain.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Array of Point Counts
hints.text: Compute the number of integer points inside each rectangle as width times height. Build a prefix sum array and use binary search to pick a rectangle.

hints.title: Two-Stage Sampling Blueprint
hints.text: Precompute prefix sums of point counts for each rectangle. In pick(): sample a random target between 1 and total points. Use bisect_left on prefix sums to locate the rectangle. Pick random x and y uniformly within that rectangle.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import bisect
import random

class Solution:
    def __init__(self, rects: list[list[int]]):
        self.rects = rects
        self.prefix = []
        total = 0
        for x1, y1, x2, y2 in rects:
            points = (x2 - x1 + 1) * (y2 - y1 + 1)
            total += points
            self.prefix.append(total)
        self.total = total

    def pick(self) -> list[int]:
        target = random.randint(1, self.total)
        idx = bisect.bisect_left(self.prefix, target)
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = self.rects[idx]
        return [random.randint(x1, x2), random.randint(y1, y2)]
```

complexity.notes: Initial construction builds prefix array in O(N); each pick runs in O(log N) binary search time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Picking rectangles uniformly creates bias toward points in smaller rectangles.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix sum array enables logarithmic binary search rectangle selection.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct point count formula including both endpoints: (x2 - x1 + 1) * (y2 - y1 + 1).
